entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7063"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 136</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.136.1-Ps.136.26">Psa 136:1-26</reference>. The theme is the same as that of Psalm 135. God should be praised for His works of creation and providence, His deliverance and care of His people, and judgments on their enemies, and His goodness to all. The chorus to every verse is in terms of that of <reference osisRef="Ps.106.1">Psa 106:1</reference>; <reference osisRef="Ps.118.1-Ps.118.4">118:1-4</reference>, and was perhaps used as the Amen by the people, in worship (compare <reference osisRef="1Chr.16.36">1Ch 16:36</reference>; <reference osisRef="Ps.105.45">Psa 105:45</reference>).</title> <div sID="gen10834" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7063"/>1-3. The divine titles denote supremacy. <div eID="gen10834" type="x-p"/>
